2609.02760.title: Measurement-Driven Sub-Network Selection for On-Premise Retrieval-Augmented Factory Agents
2609.02760.paper_summary: On-premise assistants can give factory workers conversational access to machine documentation, but models capable of the task rarely fit shop-floor hardware. We show that after structural compression and retrieval-grounded adaptation, model size is no longer a reliable predictor of adapted answer quality: general capability falls almost linearly with parameter count, while judged retrieval-augmented answer quality does not. We therefore treat deployment as a post-adaptation selection problem, committing one sub-network per device on judged answer quality and measured on-device throughput under a configurable general-capability floor and memory budget; rules that optimize size, speed, or quality alone each give up capability or throughput. A weight-shared supernetwork trained with sandwich-style in-place distillation keeps this selection inexpensive. In a manufacturing-manual case study, extraction costs 13.7 percent of the unpruned model's judged quality and retrieval-grounded distillation returns it to within 4.6 percent, recovering two thirds of the loss, and the same assistant runs across three heterogeneous edge tiers at 1.3 to 5 watts standby.
2609.02760.paper_summary_zh: 在現場助手可以讓工廠工人以對話方式訪問機器文檔，但能夠執行此任務的模型很少適合車間硬體。<lb/>我們顯示，在結構壓縮和基於檢索的適應之後，模型大小不再是適應後答案質量的可靠預測指標：一般能力幾乎隨著參數數量線性下降，而經評估的檢索增強答案質量則不是。<lb/>因此，我們將部署視為一個後適應選擇問題，根據經評估的答案質量和在可配置的一般能力底線及內存預算下測量的設備吞吐量，為每個設備承諾一個子網絡；單獨優化大小、速度或質量的規則各自放棄了能力或吞吐量。<lb/>一個使用三明治式現場蒸餾訓練的權重共享超網絡使這一選擇變得廉價。在一個製造手冊的案例研究中，提取成本為未修剪模型的經評估質量的13.7％，而基於檢索的蒸餾將其恢復至4.6％以內，回收了三分之二的損失，相同的助手在三個異構邊緣層上以1.3到5瓦的待機功耗運行。
